$comment: Fourteen invented cases for the demo, from the invented insurer Thornmere Mutual Insurance. The reporters, claimants, policies, claims and documents do not exist. Loss report: LR-3001 complete, LR-3002 a wrong policy number and no date of loss, LR-3003 a cancelled policy, LR-3004 a person injured. Sorting: CLM-4001 fast track, CLM-4003 complex, CLM-4005 person first, CLM-4008 standard. Pack check: CLM-4001 complete, CLM-4002 one document missing and one that cannot be read, CLM-4005 one missing and one that names another registration. Summary: CLM-4001 nothing open, CLM-4002 two open points, CLM-4007 two records that disagree and a vulnerable customer. Each case names only what the insurer's claims system holds. The list is written last case first, because the desk shows the last case entered at the top: the loss reports lead the queue.

cases.title: Whitlocke, hit from behind: loss report
cases.policy: POL-2014, as the reporter gave it
cases.text:
THE LOSS REPORT
Loss report: LR-3004
Reporter: Ansel Whitlocke
Channel: web form
Received: 26 Nov 2026
Policy given: POL-2014
THE REPORT, AS IT ARRIVED
Policy POL-2014. On 25 Nov 2026 at about 08:10 on the Beacon Hill roundabout in Marlow Reach, a van ran into the back of my Vesper Lane estate (registration MR-8842-P). My wife, Corisande Whitlocke, was in the passenger seat and was taken to hospital by ambulance with back pain. The van was a white Orrin Bay van, registration PI-4471-V, driven by a Mr Tobin Halewood. The rear of my car is badly damaged.
THE AGENT'S TASK
The agent takes from the report who reports, what happened, when and where. It finds the policy and has the policy system say whether the policy was in force on the date of the loss. It prepares the claim file and lists what is missing. Everything here is as the claims system holds it. The agent reads the report itself from the claims system.
